summary: A Work Plane becomes a named Part::LocalCoordinateSystem held in the Job's Workplanes group that several Operations link to, with a new CAM_Workplane command, a Work plane selector and Reset to defaults button on every Operation's Heights page, a renamed context-menu action, and a rule that a Job without rotary axes refuses a tilted Work Plane.

pages.reason: Path/Main/Gui/WorkplaneCmd.py: new command CAM_Workplane added to projcmdlist in InitGui.py; creates a plane from a selected planar face or at Job origin; Path/Main/Workplane.py: tilted plane refused on a Job without rotary axes

InitGui.py: projcmdlist gains CAM_Workplane; Path/Op/Gui/Base.py: context action renamed 'Set Work Plane from Face' and now creates a shared plane; PageHeightsEdit.ui: heights are measured along the tool axis of the work plane
Path/Main/Job.py: setupWorkplanes adds a Workplanes group child under the Job (claimChildren in Gui/Job.py) and onDelete removes it with the Job; hidden Workplanes link property
